test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a poverty alleviation programme in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Namami Gange**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Namami Gange** is NOT a poverty alleviation programme in India.
 
• Namami Gange is an integrated conservation mission, approved as the 'Flagship Programme' by the Union Government in June 2014 with a budget outlay of Rs. 20,000 Crore to accomplish the twin objectives of effective abatement of pollution, conservation, and rejuvenation of the National River Ganga.
 
• It focuses on activities such as sewage treatment infrastructure, river surface cleaning, rural sanitation, and afforestation.
 
• Other options like **Indira Awaas Yojana (IAY)**, **Rural Employment Generation Programme (REGP)**, and **Sampoorna Grameen Rozgar Yojana (SGRY)** are indeed poverty alleviation programmes aimed at improving living conditions and providing employment opportunities in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indira Awaas Yojana (IAY)** was a major scheme for constructing houses for the rural poor in India, which has now been subsumed under the Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana (PMAY).
 
• **Rural Employment Generation Programme (REGP)** aimed at generating employment opportunities in rural areas through the establishment of micro-enterprises.
 
• **Sampoorna Grameen Rozgar Yojana (SGRY)** was launched to provide additional wage employment and food security in rural areas, along with the creation of durable community assets.
 
• The **Namami Gange Programme** focuses on the holistic rejuvenation of the Ganga river and does not directly address poverty alleviation.
